summary: Lake County, MN stairway tower No. 106 (79.5 ft) moved in 1958-59 to the Argus site in St. Louis County; gone from the Lake site by 1976 and listed gone at Argus.

facts.design: Stairway tower, about 80 ft (79.5 ft in survey table), numbered 106
facts.status_note: Moved to the Argus site in St. Louis County (1958 per Lake County survey, 1959 per St. Louis County survey); gone from the Lake County site by 1976; no source describes what remains at either site
facts.agency: Minnesota Forest Service (now Minnesota DNR Forestry Division), per the Lake County survey footnote

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Lake County survey and statewide list say the tower moved to Argus in 1958; the St. Louis County survey dates the Argus tower 1959. Both years are kept as separate events.
Index and brief use Bud Hill; both county surveys spell it Budd Hill. The story uses Bud Hill and notes the survey spelling.

notes_for_editor: Two county surveys and a statewide list agree the tower moved to the Argus site, but disagree on the year (1958 vs 1959). No source describes what remains at the Lake County site or at Argus today, and no build date or access information was found. The surveys spell the name Budd Hill. The brief's status 'gone' stands.
